title: AXIOM-SC KG Rule
description: Schema for a single mechanistic rule in the AXIOM-SC knowledge graph.

cell_type.description: Cell type this rule applies to.

rule_type.description: positive=affirmative support; negative=contradiction; circuit=co-expression requirement; spatial=niche-dependent.

evidence_source.description: Which evidence stream this rule draws on.

gene_or_regulon.description: Gene symbols or regulon names (TF symbols) that define this rule.

direction.description: The directional condition that triggers this rule.

paired_with.description: Additional genes that must also satisfy their condition (used in composite rules).

incompatible_with.description: Cell types that are mutually exclusive with a PROVEN verdict for this type.

mechanistic_basis.description: Why this rule is mechanistically valid. Must cite a biological mechanism.

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the primary supporting paper.

tissue_context.description: Tissues where this rule is valid. Empty list = universal.

source_db.description: Database or resource that provided the marker/regulon basis.

status.description: Only ACTIVE rules are used during annotation.

added_in_version.description: axiom-sc version when this rule was added.
